subject.title: fix(googlechat): media downloads can grow unbounded without a size cap

question: Should the exported Google Chat media helper fail closed at the documented 20 MiB default when direct callers omit `maxBytes`?
rationale: The patch fixes an unbounded buffering bug, but it changes omitted-cap behavior from uncapped to fail-closed for direct helper callers, so maintainer intent should accept that compatibility tradeoff before merge.

options.title: Accept the 20 MiB helper default
options.body: Land this patch with the documented Google Chat media default and require direct callers that need larger media to pass an explicit `maxBytes`.

options.title: Pause for API-contract clarification
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want omitted `maxBytes` to retain a different public meaning and ask for that contract to be documented and tested first.

recommendation.title: Accept the 20 MiB helper default
recommendation.body: Land this patch with the documented Google Chat media default and require direct callers that need larger media to pass an explicit `maxBytes`.
